The '''Wooded Valley''' was located south of [[Castle Organa]] on the [[Apalis Coast]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], and was the site of the main roadway between the [[House Organa (estate)|House Organa estate]] and the [[Alsakan Lowlands]] to the east. During the [[Alderaan Civil War]], the trees in the northern part of the valley were cut down, leading to that section becoming known as the [[Deforested Slopes]]. The [[Spears of Organa]] were located in the valley.
